evidence.observation: Monotonic pressure rise during growth at constant Ar flow: 3.079→3.138→3.193→3.302→3.377 Torr (k=20..25), vs ~3.04-3.05 Torr stable through ramp
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not a flow change
Temperature holding 750 °C with stable heater power ~44-45%, control nominal
Sensor not installed per manifest; atmosphere/leak status cannot be verified with installed sensors

args.missing_evidence: No exhaust O2 channel exists on this furnace, so a leak cannot be distinguished from an exhaust restriction by telemetry; an Ar flow step (or brief pump-down/valve test) to see whether pressure tracks flow, plus a downstream pressure/valve position reading, would discriminate exhaust_blockage from seal_leak.
